training_data.expected_volume: unknown; likely limited because interventions are infrequent and heterogeneous

training_data.train_validation_split: prospective split by organization or time; random row splits would leak organizational context

training_data.representativeness_risks: organizational culture, occupation, shift, region, workforce composition, intervention fidelity, and management practice differ materially
training_data.feedback_loop: worker participation, SST review, intervention adoption, follow-up outcomes, and explicit correction of causal claims
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: no individual mental-health, employability, disciplinary, compensation, promotion, dismissal, or medical scoring; use aggregated groups and purpose-limited occupational-risk governance
